Ben (Finance): Quick sync: we're proposing an A/B price rollout that tests per-token bands vs tiered bundles. Need gating approvals and a small cohort plan that doesn't touch public pricing.

Ellie (Billing): OK. We should ensure invoice CSVs explicitly show which pricing arm applied. Suggest column `pricing_arm=A|B` and `bundle_applied=true|false`.

Hiro (RevOps): For comms, cohort A should get "rate preview" messaging only. Cohort B gets preview + an invite to opt into bundles. We'll only surface opt-in after the canary looks good. :email:

Megan (Product): Technical constraints: can we run A as new per-token bands (v3) and B as current bands + optional bundle credits? Need API fields: `active_pricing_arm` and `bundle_id` in /billing. Also include `effective_ts`.

Jonas (Billing Ops): Metering: we'll tag accounts with acct.meta.pricing_arm=A|B and emit `pricing_arm` on staged aggregates. I'll add a toggle and a dry-run mode so invoices are preview-only. Proration: bundles should only start on next billing cycle unless customer opts in.

Ben (Finance): Runbook (short):
```
- Create test cohorts (0.25% each) + verify tagging in staging tenant
- Emit pricing_arm in metering pipeline (staging)
- Generate invoice_preview CSV with columns: account_id,billing_cycle,plan,pricing_arm,bundle_applied,invoice_preview_amount,tokens_billed
- Run csv diff vs baseline and token reconciliation for 14 days
- Canary: 0.25% A, 0.25% B for 72h, monitor invoice_preview_count, refunds_count, opt-in_rate
- Gating: block if refunds_count > 2 or token_delta_pct > 5% or opt-in_rate < 0.1% (indicates UI problem)
- Rollback: toggle off tags, regenerate previews, send follow-up to any customers who saw previews
```

Ellie (Billing): I'll produce the sample CSV by EOD. Will include a small script to validate `pricing_arm` consistency across ledger + previews.

Hiro (RevOps): I'll draft two short emails and an in-product preview banner. Also will prepare an FAQ about proration and bundle opt-in.

BillingBot: Ticket FIN-6781 created by Ben (Finance): "cohort pricing A/B - gating + runbook". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-6781

Megan (Product): Please add a smoke eval that includes long system prompts and multi-message threads; historically that affects token accounting.

Jonas (Billing Ops): Will add reconcile job to compare staged tokens to prod baseline and alert on >5% per-account divergence to #billing-alerts. Also will ensure preview-only invoices are never sent to payment processor.

Ben (Finance): Meeting tomorrow 10:30 to approve canary window. Action items: Ellie => CSV + validation script, Jonas => feature flag + reconcile job, Hiro => comms drafts, Megan => API PR for `pricing_arm`. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
